results.explanation: Zechariah sees a solid gold lampstand (מְנוֹרָה H4501) with seven lamps (נֵר H5216) fed by two olive trees/oil (שֶׁמֶן/יִצְהָר H8081/H3323); v.6 declares "not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit (רוּחִי H7307)"; v.10 identifies the seven ("שִׁבְעָה־אֵלֶּה") with the eyes of the LORD (עֵינֵי יְהוָה H5869) ranging through the whole earth.
results.uncertainty_note: Zech 4:2–10 links lampstand, oil, Spirit, and seven eyes within the vision; its equation with Rev 4:5 and Rev 5:6 rests on cross-references and shared septuagint/vision vocabulary rather than an explicit quotation formula.
